entities.summary: The Incheon Airport Maglev is a maglev line in South Korea that opened on 3 February 2016. It was the world's second commercially operating unmanned urban maglev line after Japan's Linimo. The trains were lighter, cutting construction costs in half. The majority of construction was completed by November 2012. Operations were temporarily suspended from 14 July 2022, and the line reopened on 17 October 2025.
